data.title: Getafe vs Brighton & Hove Albion - prediction, preview & betting tips - 05/11/2026
data.content:
Evan Ferguson (ankle), Stefanos Tzimas (ACL), Zadok Yohanna (knock), Femi Azeez (muscle), Kaoru Mitoma (hamstring), and Ferdi Kadioglu (hip) are all confirmed out, while Pascal Struijk will need a late fitness test to confirm his availability.

While this will be the first competitive clash between these sides, it is worth mentioning that they met in a friendly in August 2021, with Getafe winning by two unanswered goals.

## Getafe vs Brighton & Hove Albion form guide & betting tips [...] Long-term absentee forward Christantus Uche remains the only player sidelined for the La Liga side. Mario Martin and Johan Mojica should return to the starting XI after both players missed last weekend's victory over Sevilla due to suspension.

data.title: Trabzonspor vs. Freiburg prediction, preview & betting tips – 05/11/2026
data.content:
Paul Onuachu has also been listed among Trabzonspor's injury concerns, while Sidny Lopes Cabral is suspended following his dismissal against Hearts.

Mohamed Salah has scored in both of the club's Conference League matches so far and should again be an important figure in the final third.

Julian Schuster's side beat Jablonec before suffering a 3-0 defeat away to Monaco, leaving them with three points from their first two fixtures in this competition. [...] Trabzonspor have several injury concerns ahead of Thursday's match, as Aral Simsir and Franculino were unavailable for the recent fixture against Gaziantep, while Cihan Canak and Onuralp Cevikkan are also carrying muscle problems and are doubtful.

Arseniy Batagov is expected to remain out with a hamstring injury, while Ruslan Malinovskyi and Okay Yokuslu are also sidelined.
